meta.library_note: 19 onshore upstream construction modules (pads, wellsite hook-up, flowlines, central facility, power, automation, start-up), authored by VissRad. Demonstration norms, not market or benchmark data: calibrate to your own history before a plan is issued.

event.name: Three-Pad Field Development and Central Facility (synthetic demo)

materials.desc: Conductor pipe, 20 in, set and grouted
Wellsite piping, 4 in average, sch 80, with fittings
Facility piping, 6 in average, with fittings
Flowline pipe, 6 in steel, FBE coated
Structural steel, pipe rack and supports

modules.name: Mobilization, permits and temporary facilities
modules.desc: Mobilize the field: execution plan, permits and the site safety plan, field office, laydown and pipe yard, temporary power and water, and housing where the field is remote.

tasks.desc: Execution plan, permits and site safety plan
Field office, laydown and pipe yard ({ACRES} acres)

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Lease roads and access
modules.desc: New lease roads and upgrades to county roads: survey and stake, clear, cut and fill, culverts and cattle guards, caliche surfacing, compaction and grading.
modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Well pad construction
modules.desc: Build the drilling pad: strip topsoil, cut and fill, compact, caliche, stormwater berms, cellars and conductor pipe for each well, and rig anchors, ready for the drilling rig.

tasks.desc: Cellars and conductor pipe ({WELLS} per pad)
Rig anchors, survey and pad released to drilling

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Facility pad, foundations and containment
modules.desc: The central facility site: pad grading, equipment foundations and skid supports, tank ring walls, lined secondary containment and the facility fence.

tasks.desc: Tank ring walls and lined containment

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Wellhead hook-up and wellsite piping
modules.desc: After the rig and frac crews leave: production tree connections, chokes and flowline risers, the pad manifold and test header, sand separators, chemical injection skids and the wellsite instrument stands.

tasks.desc: Hook-up crew mobilized to the pad
Wellhead connections, chokes and risers ({WELLS} wells)
Pad manifold, test header and piping ({LF} ft)
Set chemical injection skids and tubing

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Artificial lift
modules.desc: Lift for each well once flowing pressure falls: gas lift injection lines and meters, electric submersible pump (ESP) surface equipment and VFDs, or rod pump units on the pads.

tasks.desc: Gas lift lines, injection meters and piping

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Flowlines and gathering lines
modules.desc: Buried lines from the pads to the central facility -- production flowlines, gas lift supply and water lines -- in welded steel or fused HDPE: clear, ditch, string, weld or fuse, lower in, backfill, test and clean up.

tasks.desc: Field joint coating and holiday test
Tie-ins at the pad and facility

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Separation and treating equipment
modules.desc: Inlet slug catcher or free-water knockout, production and test separators, heater treaters and gun barrels: set, level, anchor and hook up skid piping, with burner management on fired vessels.

tasks.desc: Set and level vessels and skids ({N})
Burner management and stacks on fired vessels ({FIRED})

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Tank battery, vapor recovery and LACT
modules.desc: Oil and water storage tanks on ring walls, walkways and stairs, thief hatches and vents, the vapor recovery unit, the LACT unit and the truck load-out.

queries.prompt: LACT unit to the oil pipeline?

tasks.desc: Vapor recovery unit and vapor piping
Leak test and tank battery walkdown

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Gas compression
modules.desc: Packaged reciprocating or screw compressors for gas sales, gas lift or vapor recovery boost: set the packages, align, suction and discharge piping, coolers, scrubbers and blowdown, then start-up with the packager.
modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Gas dehydration and treating
modules.desc: TEG dehydration with its reboiler and BTEX control, H2S treating where the gas is sour, and the sales gas meter run.

tasks.desc: Sales gas meter run and tie-in

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Produced water and saltwater disposal
modules.desc: Produced water handling: skim tanks, filtration, transfer and injection pumps, the SWD wellhead hook-up and the water piping, sized by barrels of water per day.

tasks.desc: Set skim tanks and filtration skids
SWD wellhead hook-up and injection line

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Flare, combustors and relief
modules.desc: Emissions control and relief: flare stack or enclosed combustors, the knockout drum, the relief and blowdown header to the flare, and the pilot and ignition system.

tasks.desc: Flare stack or combustors and knockout drum

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Pipe rack and facility interconnect piping
modules.desc: Pipe rack or sleepers through the facility and the interconnect piping between separation, treating, compression, tanks and water, with supports, testing and coating.

tasks.desc: Erect pipe rack and sleepers ({TONS} t)

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Overhead power distribution
modules.desc: Field power from the utility point of delivery: overhead distribution line to each pad and the facility, pole-mounted transformers and reclosers, and the facility switchgear.
modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Facility and pad electrical
modules.desc: MCC / VFD buildings or E-houses, cable tray and conduit, power and control cable to every motor, heater and instrument, grounding and area lighting on the pads and facility.
modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Automation, SCADA and safety systems
modules.desc: Wellsite RTUs and the facility PLC, field instruments and analyzers, emergency shutdown and gas detection, radio or fiber to the SCADA host, and the point-to-point and loop checks.

tasks.desc: PLC and RTU panels, radios and network
SCADA host integration and alarm tests

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Pre-commissioning and turnover
modules.desc: Construction to operations by system: walkdowns and punch lists, flushing and blowdown, nitrogen purge and leak test, ESD function tests, and system turnover packages to the production team.

tasks.desc: Flush, blow down and nitrogen purge
ESD function and shutdown key tests
Clear punch and turn over systems

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Start-up, first oil and well turn-in-line
modules.desc: Introduce hydrocarbons system by system, bring wells on one at a time (turn-in-line), tune separators and treaters, first sales through the LACT and the gas meter, and a stable-operation run before handover.

tasks.desc: First oil sales and gas sales
